added.summary: `og style init <name> [project] [--from <theme>]` starts a style at `assets/styles/<name>/theme.json` from one of the engine's themes (minimal by default); it never overwrites.
`og style validate <directory>` compiles the style's theme.json, parses its pack.json and reports pack variants that paint a ground without its ink; it exits 1 on a problem.
Reads `.tsx` as well as `.ts`, and reports class literals: an arbitrary hex colour (`bg-[#0af]`), a fixed corner (`rounded-lg`, `rounded-t-md`) and the retired cuts (`nine-socket`, `nine-panel-cut`).

fixed.summary: The walk no longer follows directory symlinks and skips `cooked/`.

A style with both theme.json and pack.json is checked as the cook lays them (the pack over the theme, both over the default pack); a default import of a string table (`import strings from "./x.en.ogt"`) counts as importing it; fixed side or corner radii and `nine-socket` count as visual literals.
Rewires a game's imports written with single quotes as well as double quotes.
A directory of `.css` files is no longer taken for a style pack.
